question: On the frozen exact f696 A0 0bp Tiered account path, what uniform fraction of all negative cash and/or SOXL-relative selection log contributions would have to be erased by a perfect hindsight oracle to clear SOXX wealth, both complete-year and 70% rolling126 positivity gates?

method.population: All944 daily exact-f696 Tiered sessions, both partial endpoint years, complete2024/2025, 16quarters and all819 overlapping contiguous126-session windows

components.both: sum of cash and selection nonnegative erasures

method.static_oracle: For each route, add the same fraction f in [0,1] of its outcome-known negative component erasure to the original daily paired log excess; freeze all original proposals, holdings, risk state, fees, timing and NAV path. Positive protective components are never removed.
method.threshold: Compute the infimum f from full-log, two annual and the574th ordered window break-even ratio; evaluate at the next floating value above f to respect strict positivity. Report if f>1 or no capacity.
method.interpretation: These are perfect hindsight fixed-path necessary accounting effect sizes, not a feasible factor, own-state counterfactual or proof that a particular policy can attain them.

stop: Stop on source SHA/NAS/Qlib calendar, 944/16/819 coverage, daily component closure or source rolling sums mismatch. No factor sign, threshold or trading rule chosen from the oracle.
